sources.label: Official Missguided product-page Size Guide (Body Measurements, cm)

audit: missguided.co.uk redirects to missguided.com/market-uk. Same Body Measurements chart on two tops; page says sizes are for reference only. Replaces an unsourced numeric chart labelled as archived pre-2022 sizing (UK 10 87/69/93). This is the current site's chart; nothing official found for pre-2022 garments. US/EU removed (not printed). Height column not stored.
notes: UK fast fashion brand (now Shein-owned, but enormous second-hand presence — 1.6M Vinted listings). UK numeric sizing. Highly inconsistent — sizing varied dramatically between ranges and seasons. ALWAYS use measurements for pre-loved purchases. This chart is from today's missguided.com; no official chart was found for garments made before the 2022 sale, and they may differ.
